description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for managing and inspecting Windows Access Control Lists (ACLs), including parsing icacls output, classifying principals, and generating commands to reset ACLs.

classes.name: WindowsAclEntry
classes.description: Represents a single ACL entry with principal, rights, and permissions flags.

classes.name: WindowsAclSummary
classes.description: Summarizes the ACL entries, categorizing them into trusted, untrusted world, and untrusted group entries.

methods.name: parseIcaclsOutput
methods.description: Parses the output of the icacls command into WindowsAclEntry objects.

methods.name: summarizeWindowsAcl
methods.description: Classifies ACL entries into trusted, untrusted world, and untrusted group categories based on principals.

methods.name: inspectWindowsAcl
methods.description: Asynchronously inspects the ACL of a given path, returning a summary including trusted and untrusted entries.

methods.name: formatWindowsAclSummary
methods.description: Formats the ACL summary into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatIcaclsResetCommand
methods.description: Generates a command string to reset ACLs on a target path.

methods.name: createIcaclsResetCommand
methods.description: Creates a structured object representing the command to reset ACLs, including command, args, and display string.
